title: A media import outside the Gallery never becomes a card - move the ItemGroup build out of MpiGalleryBlock

summary: Carded from MPI-721's app verification: a PromptBox drop outside the Gallery stages the chip but never builds an ItemGroup, because media:imported's only listener is inside MpiGalleryBlock and one block is mounted at a time. Plan written (plan.md). Does NOT block MPI-721. Hard constraint from Fabio: the importer must not navigate - the card appears in the gallery, the user stays on the history group they are editing.
Starting MPI-723: split the media:imported listener - ItemGroup build to an app-lifetime service, grid repaint stays in the gallery block.

Shipped: mediaImportService owns the media:imported -> ItemGroup build, started once from shell.js; MpiGalleryBlock keeps only the project:group-added repaint. 921 unit tests green, two new desktop tests green in a real Electron instance and negative-controlled against the bug. It does NOT navigate. validating on one thing only - Fabio's own drop in the running app. MPI-678's Record gate is no longer load-bearing; lifting it stays out of scope.

Fabio verified all three surfaces in the running app 2026-09-11: big-area drop still arms the Place gizmo, PromptBox drop gives a chip AND a gallery card, and the + button's picker upload lands in both the prompt box and the gallery. Rule files updated with his explicit permission (component-events-blocks, component-events-primitives).
